title: Lease session lock in UpdateAsync
desc: Full data service: session lease stored inside the save and taken/checked in one UpdateAsync, dirty flags, retries, save slots, parallel shutdown flush with deadline.

title: Grouped profile template with _Meta
desc: Data template grouped by purpose (Stats, Progression, Inventory, Monetization, Cooldowns, Admin audit trail) with a _Meta block holding version and session lease.

title: DataService with separate lock store
desc: GetAsync/SetAsync with 2^n backoff, a separate SESSION-LOCK store claimed with UpdateAsync, reconcile against DefaultStats, 60s autosave and parallel BindToClose that waits for saves.

title: ProfileStore session + legacy import
desc: ProfileStore usage: StartSessionAsync with Cancel, OnSessionEnd kick, OnSave hook that encodes data, one-time import from an older plain DataStore, server-validated settings remotes.

title: Template built by functions + reconcile
desc: Data template as a New() function (fresh tables every call), per-season record ensured on load, and a shallow Reconcile for fields added later.

title: ProfileService service with migration sweep
desc: ProfileService load/release, leaderstats mirror, migration sweep that drops items no longer in config, debounced ScheduleSave, and an admin data wipe (WipeProfileAsync).

title: Minimal ProfileService setup
desc: The shortest correct ProfileService setup: LoadProfileAsync, AddUserId, Reconcile, ListenToRelease kick, release on leave, handle players already in game.

title: Knit DataService with big template
desc: Knit service with a very large commented default template, deep reconcile, path-based Set/Increment through a Replica, 5-minute autosave, and a 1-second boost countdown.

title: Dirty-only autosave + mirrors
desc: Small data core: deep reconcile, value sanitising on load, Update(changes, removals) that marks dirty and mirrors to attributes/leaderstats, autosave only for dirty players.

title: BIG Games DataStore wrapper
desc: BIG Games framework wrapper: Get/Set/Update with retries, refuses nil writes, caches DataStore objects by name/scope.

title: Save loop with PlayingSession flag
desc: BIG Games saving: a PlayingSession flag in the save acts as a simple session lock (retry until the old server cleared it), new-stat backfill, staggered save loop, change-diff replication.

title: Session store + trade save-lock
desc: Separate SessionStore with a heartbeat-style timestamp (90s timeout), plus a SaveLocked flag used to freeze saves during trades so items cannot be duplicated.

title: Stravant's PlayerDataStore (classic)
desc: The classic community PlayerDataStore module (by Stravant): cached SaveData objects, passive saves, Flush, and atomic multi-key Update meant for dev product purchases.

title: SessionStore (lease lock + migrations)
desc: Standalone player data store: lease-based session lock inside the save, numbered migrations, template reconcile, dirty autosave that renews the lease, parallel BindToClose, Studio memory mode.

title: SafeDataStore (retry wrapper)
desc: Retrying wrapper for Get/Set/Update/Remove with exponential backoff, request-budget waiting, one call per key at a time, and (success, value) returns.
